95:         return x.copy()
96: 
97:     @staticmethod
98:     def from_numpy(x):
99:         return x
100: 
101:     @staticmethod
102:     def is_array(x):
103:         return type(x) is _np.ndarray
104: 
105:     @staticmethod
106:     def is_float(x):
107:         return isinstance(x, (_np.floating, float))
108: 
109:     @staticmethod
110:     def is_float32(x):
111:         return isinstance(x, _np.float32)
112: 
113:     @staticmethod
114:     def is_float64(x):
115:         return isinstance(x, _np.float64)
116: 
117:     @staticmethod
118:     def ndim(x):
119:         return x.ndim
120: 
121:     @staticmethod
122:     def to_numpy(x):
123:         return x
124: 
125: 
126: class NumPyLinalg:
127:     def __init__(self):
128:         self.inv = _np.linalg.inv
129:         self.norm = _np.linalg.norm
130: 
131: 
132: class NumPyRandom:
133:     def __init__(self):
134:         self.rand = _np.random.rand
135:         self.randint = _np.random.randint
136:         self.randn = _np.random.randn
137:

139: class NumPyTesting:
140:     def __init__(self):
141:         self.assert_allclose = _np.testing.assert_allclose
142:         self.assert_equal = _np.testing.assert_equal
